title: terminal-code: a VS Code window where every pixel is drawn into your terminal grid

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Terminal code runs VS Code in your terminal by stacking two pieces. Code server puts VS code in a browser and their terminal browser renders that browser through the Kitty graphics protocol. It's real VS Code drawn as pixels in your terminal grid. over SSH to SSH keeps the front end local and only the backend remote.
